description: Historique des données de production et de consommation d’électricité au Québec is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. Jeu de données d’Hydro‑Québec sur la production et la distribution d’électricité au Québec. Mises à jour annuellement, les données sont transmises à la Régie de l’énergie du Québec après leur vérification comptable. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Hydro-Québec. It offers 4 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2023-06-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
